# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This knowledge base is distilled from a series of genuine sales calls, dealer negotiations, price update discussions, and customer service interactions for **Crayon Roofing & Structures** (also referred to in calls as *Cryon*, *Creon*, or *Kriyaan*). 

The transcripts reveal a fast-paced, highly market-sensitive sales environment in Tamil Nadu. The business deals in metal roofing sheets, polycarbonate sheets, purlins, self-drilling screws, and welding electrodes. The sales team constantly manages rapid price fluctuations, stock availability of steel coils, logistical challenges (such as rain damage to cargo), and technical consultations with dealers and fabricators.
